title: Silk Roads: Chang'an–Tianshan corridor
summary: This 33-site World Heritage corridor, listed in 2014 by China, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan, traces the Silk Roads from Han and Tang Chang'an and Luoyang through the Hexi Corridor to the Zhetysu region. It took shape between about 200 BCE and 100 CE and stayed in use until about the 16th century.

uncertainty.note: The corridor formed between 200 BCE and 100 CE according to the tour-guide source; it remained in use to about the 16th century. The 2014 listing is a later designation.
